span.p:
Invariants
• No shell interpolation: every git call is argv-based
• Commits stage named paths; CommitAll is the save exception
• .main holds state; project worktrees hold work product
• edit and journal leave files dirty for grind save
• save is local; push and pull are the only network verbs
